value.rationale: A natural additional physical constant-mass integration criterion forces a different exact closed FSBP grid size from the derivative-product-only case. While abstract minimality follows general moment theory, the closed-form hyperbolic parameters remove an abstract nonlinear quadrature solve in a parameter family, identifies strict positivity for all real frequencies, and supplies a logarithmic endpoint-node layer and reciprocal endpoint-weight law for numerical steep-layer grid design. This is a complete exact structural benchmark, not an arbitrary finite table, and claims no general PDE convergence theorem.
